description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableThingDefinition' that implements the 'ThingDefinition' interface, representing a unique identifier for a 'Thing' with namespace, name, and version components.

classes.name: ImmutableThingDefinition
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ThingDefinition interface, providing methods to create and parse identifiers, and override standard Object methods.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableThingDefinition instance with specified namespace, name, and version.

methods.name: ofParsed
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence to create an ImmutableThingDefinition, or returns it if already of that type.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component of the identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name component of the identifier.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version component of the identifier.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the delegate identifier.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the delegate identifier.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the delegate identifier.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified index in the delegate identifier.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the delegate identifier.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the delegate identifier.
